text: Motor enclosure: TEFC (IP55 minimum indoors, IP56 outdoors), marine grade C5 painting per ISO 12944-2, stainless steel fasteners and nameplates, space heaters for MV motors and motors with a standstill period, drain holes with protection against condensation. Seawater-side motors (CW pump house) shall have IP56 and an anti-corrosion coating suitable for C5-H.
